**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (a.novak, gateway) shipped a config change flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true` and raising `gateway.timeout.upstreamMs` from `2000` to `2500`. Applied as config generation 119 at `2026-03-14T02:13:41.234Z`. This exhausts the connection pool (`size 20, in_use 20`), so requests queue and time out with `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

**Impact window:** Started `2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z` (first 503). Still ongoing as of the last log line, `03:59:27.974Z` — the wait queue has grown from 13 to 74 requests, so it's worsening, not recovering. Gateway-only: `logs/worker.log` shows no errors or slowdowns in this window, since workers don't go through the affected pool.

**Rollback:** `dep-4471` on gateway. Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false` (and optionally the timeout back to `2000ms`).
